summary: Model family choice significantly affects predictive performance. The best model ('Gradient Boosting', ROC-AUC: 0.9279) outperforms the worst ('KNN', ROC-AUC: 0.8457) by 0.0822 (9.72%), indicating that model selection meaningfully impacts performance on this dataset.
methodological_choices: Train-test split: 70-30 with stratification and random_state=42. Missing value handling: categorical columns filled with 'Unknown', numerical columns filled with median. Feature encoding: LabelEncoder for categorical features, StandardScaler applied for models requiring scaled features (LogReg, SVM, KNN, NN). Evaluation metric: ROC-AUC (primary), with Accuracy and F1-Score as supporting metrics. Models trained with consistent random states where applicable. Models evaluated on same test set (n=14653) to ensure fair comparison.
